assumptions: SALT2 training, photometric calibration, selection/bias corrections, object identities and full covariance are part of the supplied distances.
1701 light curves are not 1701 independent objects; duplicates and shared Pantheon+/SH0ES calibrators must retain dependence.
predictions: SNe with a free magnitude offset constrain relative distances, not absolute H0.
A calibrated ladder needs anchor/host residuals and covariance; overlapping summary constraints cannot be multiplied as independent data.
